Meet The Tiny 6lb Puppy With Unique Needs Who is Searching For Love
Great Dog Rescue New England, a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, would like you to meet a sweet little dog named Porter. This tiny 8-week-old Australian Shepherd mix, weighing in at a mere 6.5lbs, is in search of a patient and loving forever family. While there are countless dogs in rescue care looking for their second chances, Porter comes with a disadvantage that might make it even harder to get that chance. Due to a double merle genetic defect, Porter is blind and will need a patient family that can help him with more specialized training.

After Years of Neglect This Gentle Giant is Still Waiting for Her Happily Ever After
Sandy Paws Rescue Inc., a foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, is seeking help to find a permanent home for Ava, a 5-year-old Rottweiler who continues to wait for her forever family. "Ava is still waiting for her love match! Can you share her post?" The rescue shared with their communiy. Despite her challenging past, Ava has blossomed in her foster home and is ready to find her forever family. Ava's journey began in a rural shelter in central Texas, where she was rescued after years of being used for breeding and living in a garage. "Rescued from a neglectful situation—shockingly, at the hands of a former police officer—Ava is now beginning her journey toward healing," the rescue organization shared on her profile.

Young Dog Still Searching For Home After Original Owners Refused To Neuter Him
Sandy Paws Rescue Inc., a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, recently reported that Nixon, a remarkable young dog with a difficult past, is still searching for his forever home after over five months. Nixon’s story began when he was found wandering the streets of Texas at around one year of age. When his owners were contacted to come get him, they learned that per the city ordinance, they were required to have him neutered. They reportedly responded, “You can keep him, we only got him to breed,” and effectively abandoned him. Luckily, Sandy Paws Rescue Inc. stepped in to save Nixon from becoming another statistic. Since entering their care, Nixon has spent some time in a board-and-train program in Texas and is now living with a foster family in Massachusetts.

Meet The Sweet & Social Little 8lb Puppy Looking For Love
Sandy Paws Rescue Inc., a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, recently introduced Slaw, a charismatic puppy whose quirky expressions and lovable personality are capturing hearts both in person and online! This four-month-old bundle of joy, weighing just over 8 pounds, earned her unique name as part of the rescue's BBQ-themed litter. "With expressions this awkward and a silly personality to match, Slaw was BORN to be a social media star!" the rescue enthusiastically shares. With her distinctive fox-like ears that playfully hide when she makes her signature awkward face, Slaw is expected to grow into a smaller medium-sized dog, though her exact breed mix remains a delightful mystery.

The Outlaw Who Built a Town: The Forgotten Founder of Thermopolis, Wyoming
Before it was a tourist stop famed for its hot springs, Thermopolis, Wyoming, was the vision of a daring bachelor cowboy named Ben Hanson. In the early 1890s, Hanson—a well-respected rancher and adventurer—carved a town from the rugged Owl Creek region. Despite his ambition and early success, history remembers him more for a fatal shootout than for founding one of Wyoming's most iconic communities.
